description:
One property's dated events in time order, newest first: sales (HMLR),
    EPC lodgements, listings and planning applications, 25 per page via
    `next_cursor`. `kinds` defaults to ["sale", "epc"], which are free; add
    "listing" (costs the listing_history price) or "planning" (costs the
    property_planning_history price) only when asked, each charged only when it
    returns events. A source that fails is named in the reply and not charged.

    Use it for "what has happened to this property". Do NOT use it to estimate a
    value. If the UPRN has more than 20 adverts it names a block, not one home:
    listing and planning events are then withheld, `identity` is `building` and
    the reply says the per-home history is unknown. Never invent a chain from
    it. If the advert count cannot be read, identity is `unresolved`.
    `since` is an ISO date. UK only. cost_credits is what was taken.
    Default kinds (sale, epc): Free. The listing and planning
    kinds are the exception described above. Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: property_timeline
title: One property's dated events
